decisions.question: Status glyphs: bare, and in which cut?
decisions.bar: Bare, a row mixes Solar's 1.5 line strokes with neighbours in its filled bold cut, so the bare ones read at about two thirds of their mass, and the i and ! are the weakest at 16px. The third draws the whole row in the line cut, each glyph's strokes weighed to within 0.7–1.4 of the row's ink at 16, 20 and 24px. Day on the left, night on the right, real size; hold a picture to see today's.

candidates.label: Today (in its container)
candidates.result: What ships now: each glyph on a half-ink disc.

candidates.label: Without its container
candidates.result: Discs gone; Needs you and Sleeping stay filled, so the row reads uneven.

candidates.label: The whole row in Solar's line cut
candidates.result: Line cut, even ink: i, ! and ? with heavier stems and real dots; Sleeping's moon in full ink. Stopped and Idle: the next question.

decisions.question: Line cut: Stopped and Idle, outlined or filled?
decisions.bar: Only if you pick the line cut above. Stopped and Idle go together. A filled square can't fill the row's footprint and keep the row's ink: at Solar's own size it reads as a bullet beside 12px glyphs; at the row's size it outweighs every neighbour. Day on the left, night on the right, real size; hold a picture to see today's.

candidates.label: Both outlined
candidates.result: Both in outline at the row's size and ink, like the rest; Stopped reads as an empty checkbox.

candidates.label: Both filled, Solar's size
candidates.result: Even ink with the row (0.90–1.37×), but 5.3px at 16px beside 11.7px glyphs: they read as bullets.

candidates.label: Both filled, the row's size
candidates.result: 11.7px at 16px like their neighbours, but 3.7–5.7× the row's ink: the heaviest marks in the row.
